title: Browse
subtitle: Queue a public http(s) page. Nothing is fetched until you Allow once. YOLO is off. No Chrome profile.
proposeHelp: Public http or https only. Localhost, credentials, and signed-in Chrome are refused.
queueHelp: Allow once fetches the page as plain text. Deny fetches nothing.
excerptHelp: Plain text only. Scripts and computer-use are off.
